title: Application to MVV/Residence Permit Process Steps for Netherlands
notice: No blocked account required in the Netherlands. IND needs proof of sufficient funds (~11,000–14,000 EUR). Your university sponsors your residence permit (VVR) through IND — handled by the university's International Office.

processSteps.label: University Application : via Studielink.nl or university portal
bullets: Deadlines: 1 February (main) or 1 April (second round) for September intake
Prepare: CV, Motivation Letter, 2 References, IELTS/TOEFL, transcripts

processSteps.label: Admission Letter & Scholarship Application
bullets: Apply for Holland Scholarship, Orange Tulip Scholarship, or university scholarships
Most scholarship deadlines: February–March (same as admission)

processSteps.label: University Sponsors IND Residence Permit
bullets: University's International Office submits your permit to IND — you don't apply directly
Prepare financial proof: ~11,000–14,000 EUR in bank or scholarship confirmation

processSteps.label: MVV (Entry Visa) Application at VFS Global Dhaka
bullets: Book VFS Dhaka appointment after IND approval
MVV fee: 192 EUR | VFS service fee: ~30 EUR | Processing: 3–6 weeks

processSteps.label: Arrange Housing & Health Insurance
bullets: Apply for university dorm early — housing is highly competitive
Health insurance (Zorgverzekering) required within 4 months of arrival: ~120–160 EUR/month

processSteps.label: Arrive in Netherlands & IND Check-In
bullets: Register at Gemeente for BSN (Citizen Service Number)
Report to IND within 3 days — university coordinates; collect VVR card

processSteps.label: Residence Permit (VVR) : valid for duration of studies
bullets: Part-time work: 16 hours/week during term; full-time in summer
Renewable as long as enrolled and conditions met

costSteps.label: MVV Entry Visa Fee : 192 EUR — paid at Dutch Embassy via VFS
VFS Global Service Fee : ~30 EUR — visa submission
Financial Proof in Bank : ~11,000–14,000 EUR — your own living funds, not a fee
Tuition Fee : 8,000–20,000 EUR/year — varies by university and program
Health Insurance : ~120–160 EUR/month — Zorgverzekering required within 4 months
BSN Registration : free at Gemeente (City Hall)
Air Ticket to Netherlands : varies by season and route

contacts.name: VFS Global — Netherlands Visa
contacts.address: VFS Global, Dhaka (check vfsglobal.com/Netherlands/Bangladesh for current address and appointments)
